issue_context.title: Improve error handler for v1
issue_context.body:
This issue is a central issue gathering all the changes we would like to do for v1 regarding the error handler of Meilisearch.

⚠️ Meilisearch is supposed to be breaking since v0.28.0. Because we haven't released v1 yet, we allowed some breaking changes in v0.30.0 and v0.29.0 where the user impact is minimal. However, we cannot break everything Meilisearch and their error handler, since the user impact can be huge.
**It's important to always balance btw the negative user impact of a breaking change (often huge) and the positive user impact of the new error behavior**

An internal squad will be dedicated to these potential changes. Due to the negative impact the breaking changes could have, it's also possible the squad decides to do nothing.

## Related issues

This central issue includes big changes related to the Jayson integration but also smaller bug fixes

### Priority 1

Priority because can lead to breaking changes

- Jayson integration: https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/issues/2325
  - Consider any async error we could make sync
  - Any error `code` we could improve
- https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/issues/2255
- https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/issues/2785

### Priority 2

❌ Finally not implemented for v1.0

- Related to the Jayson integration but not breaking
  - https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/issues/2808
  - https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/issues/2593
  - Improve the error `message`s
- Geosearch errors
  - https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/issues/3007
  - https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/issues/3006
  - https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/issues/3005
  - https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/issues/3003
- https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/issues/2808 (we don't know yet if something is doable or not)

## Related specs describing the changes

https://github.com/meilisearch/specifications/pull/212

## Related teams

@meilisearch/integration-team and @meilisearch/docs-team 
Here is the [slack link](https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/issues/2808) to follow the squad work (internal)
comments: @meilisearch/docs-team and @meilisearch/integration-team -> I linked the spec to the issue that describes ALL the changes
Priority 2 tasks will not be implemented for v1.0
